references.notes: The DEFAULT template and the structural reference for a new concrete site. Read the local directory, not a hosted URL: the structure is already encoded here, it costs nothing to read, and it cannot drift or 404. Fixed section order: hero → promise-bar → services-grid → testimonials → promise-band → signature-system → process-steps → about → seo-body → faq → blog-cards → closing-cta → footer. Ships a native lead form (EstimateForm → /api/estimate → thank-you), which is why it is the default: it captures leads with no paste-in, and an unattended build has nobody to paste one. Structure is reusable; COPY IS NOT — branded program names belong to whoever coined them and must never reach a generated site.

LEGACY — do not use for a new site. Retained only because sites already built on it still need their shape documented. firefly has no <form> anywhere in its source: it ships GHLFormEmbed alone and captures a lead only if a human pastes a GHL snippet during site-generate. On an unattended build nobody does, and the result is a complete, good-looking site that cannot capture a lead. That happened twice before the cause was traced. Was `role: primary` here, which is what kept pulling concrete builds back onto it after the skill default had already changed to owl.

AGC Concrete — native concrete-vertical reference for the editorial type treatment, section rhythm, earth-tone palette, and real-photography approach. Use for concrete-specific color/photography direction; use Firefly for structural patterns.

anti_patterns: purple / indigo / violet accents (unless explicitly requested)
generic construction stock photo (handshake, diverse team in hardhats)
Lucide icon rows (max 1 outline icon per section, semantic only)
"Trusted by 10,000+ customers" without a real number from GBP
randomized section order — always use the fixed order from the template
